verdict.rationale: Square provides official SDKs with concrete code examples (e.g., Node.js SDK usage for payments.create) and extensive developer documentation covering APIs like Payments, Refunds, Subscriptions, Webhooks, and Sandbox testing, confirming a build-ready official SDK ecosystem. There's also an llms.txt endpoint signaling AI-native discoverability of the developer platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond GitHub snippets, and no OpenAPI spec exposed for broader SDK generation.
